customManagers.description: CI pins zizmor inline (pipx run zizmor==X), which the pre-commit manager cannot see.
CI pins betterleaks inline (go install ...@vX), which the pre-commit manager cannot see.

packageRules.description: The vortex crates move together, crates.io pins and git tags alike: one crate per pull request leaves two vortex versions side by side in a lockfile until the last one lands.
zizmor is pinned twice, by the pre-commit hook and by the workflow that runs it at its strictest: one pull request moves both.
betterleaks is pinned twice, by the pre-commit hook and by the workflow that reads the commits a change brings: one pull request moves both.
The workflows' actions, pinned by digest: their minor and patch releases in one pull request, opened on Monday mornings.
The analyzers run at build time only: one pull request a month, on its first morning.
Zstandard and LZ4 come from one repository, released together at one version.
The compiler API the generator builds against is the oldest compiler it loads into, pinned on purpose: a newer one would raise the compiler every consumer needs.
